data.title: Sobha Central
data.about:
The Tranquil at Sobha Central is the third residential tower in the master community, following the first two towers within the complex, The Horizon and The Eden. Strategically located on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai’s most powerful business and lifestyle corridor

The project is developed by Sobha Realty, and offers 1- and 2-bedroom residences with sweeping views of the Marina, Bluewaters, and Emirates Hills. With direct access to major highways, private road networks, and a fly-out bridge, residents enjoy unmatched connectivity, world-class amenities, and elevated living in the heart of Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Sobha Central - Where Luxury Lives Tall!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Iconic Location on Sheikh Zayed Road: Strategically positioned along Dubai’s most prestigious corridor, offering unparalleled connectivity to Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
  • Masterfully Designed Towers: Six elegant towers featuring panoramic skyline views and sleek architectural design, setting a new benchmark for high-rise residential excellence.
  • Exclusive Urban Podium Park: A unique elevated community park at podium level providing serene green zones, leisure lounges, and open vistas — redefining vertical living.
  • Next-Level Connectivity Infrastructure: Features like a rare second-floor fly-out bridge and dual access lanes engineered for seamless entry and exit, similar to landmark commercial hubs.
  • Unobstructed Skyline Views: Every residence enjoys open views that stretch up to 500 meters without visual interruption, offering a liberating sense of space and openness.
  • Integrated Wellness & Lifestyle: Includes a full-fledged mall, cinema, fitness centers, prayer hall, business hubs, and retail spaces — all connected to the residential towers.

location_tile.title: Live Where Every Turn Leads to a Landmark
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in one of Dubai’s most prestigious urban corridors, Sobha Central boasts a landmark address on Sheikh Zayed Road. Whether commuting, unwinding, or exploring, residents are just minutes away from the very best the city has to offer. Beyond exceptional connectivity, the area surrounding Sobha Central is rich in lifestyle offerings. From fine dining and premium retail to wellness centers and cultural attractions, everything is within easy reach.

  • 2 minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 2 minutes to Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT)
  • 10 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 10 minutes to Jebel Ali Beach
  • 7 minutes to Ibn Battuta Mall
